title: Material Ambiguity Requires Clarification
claimTested: Spoon learns not to guess when a reference has materially different interpretations.

phases.purpose: Demonstrate appropriate clarification for an unresolved reference.

input.prompt: I have a red box and a blue box. Make it bigger.

criteria: asks which box or what dimension

phases.purpose: Require the same clarification behavior with Teacher removed.

input.prompt: I have a red box and a blue box. Make it bigger.

criteria: clarifies instead of guessing with Teacher OFF

phases.purpose: Apply the ambiguity policy to a different domain and wording.

input.prompt: There are two files, config.json and settings.json. Delete it.

criteria: does not choose a file without resolving the referent
